name: karate-tournament
description: Portable karate tournament (tatami) management app — Fastify + React + Prisma/SQLite, no Docker.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run seed
scripts.build: npm --workspace client run build && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm --workspace server run start -- 80
